'''Trun<nowiki>'</nowiki>''' was a prime crop grown on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]]. While the cold [[Poll]] season prevented the growth of many crops, Trun' could be grown all-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] round.
